name: Silver One Resources Inc.
summary: Silver One Resources Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in the United States. The company explores silver deposits. Its flagship project, the Candelaria Silver Mine project, located in Nevada; and holds 100% interest in Cherokee project located in Nevada, as well as in the Phoenix silver property located near Globe, Arizona. The company was formerly known as BRS Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to Silver One Resources Inc. in September 2016. Silver One Resources Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Westbridge Renewable Energy
summary: Westbridge Renewable Energy Corp. develops and acquires solar photovoltaic projects in Canada and the United States. Its main asset is the 278 MWp Georgetown project in Vulcan County, Alberta. It fully owns the 221 MWp Accalia project in Cameron County, Texas, and holds 75% of the 236 MWp Sunnynook Project in Alberta, which includes a 100 MW battery storage system.
